lesson1.cn: 肚子疼得厉害，在家吃了两片药，还不行。
lesson1.en: My stomach hurts badly. I took two pills at home, but it still hasn't gotten better.
lesson1.pinyin: dǔziténg dé lìhài， zàijiā chī le liǎngpiàn yào， hái bùxíng。

lesson1.en: I just ate some fish and beef.
lesson1.pinyin: jiù chī le yìxiē yú hé niúròu。

lesson1.en: I drank a bottle of beer.

lesson1.cn: 你先去化验一下儿大便，然后我再给你检查检查。
lesson1.en: Go get your stool tested first, then I'll examine you.
lesson1.pinyin: nǐ xiān qù huàyàn yíxiàr dàbiàn， ránhòu wǒ zài gěi nǐ jiǎnchá jiǎnchá。

lesson1.en: Have the lab test results come out?

lesson1.cn: 大夫，我是不是得了肠炎？
lesson1.pinyin: dàfū， wǒ shìbúshì dé le chángyán？

lesson1.en: I've looked at the test results.

lesson1.cn: 不是肠炎，只是消化不好。
先给你开一些药，再给你打一针。
lesson1.en: I'll prescribe some medicine for you first, then give you an injection.
lesson1.pinyin: xiāngěi nǐ kāi yìxiē yào， zài gěi nǐ dǎ yìzhēn。

lesson1.en: How should I take this medicine?

lesson1.cn: 一天三次，一次两片，饭后吃。
lesson1.en: Three times a day, two tablets each time, after meals.
lesson1.pinyin: yìtiān sāncì， yícì liǎngpiàn， fànhòu chī。

lesson2.cn: 因为感到寂寞，所以心情不好，很难过。
lesson2.en: Because I feel lonely, I'm in a bad mood and very sad.
lesson2.pinyin: yīnwèi gǎndào jìmò， suǒyǐ xīnqíng bùhǎo， hěn nánguò。

lesson2.cn: 我也常想家，但是不感到寂寞。
lesson2.en: I often miss home too, but I don't feel lonely.
lesson2.pinyin: wǒ yě chángxiǎngjiā， dànshì bù gǎndào jìmò。

lesson2.en: I have an older sister, and also a younger brother.

lesson2.cn: 在家时，我们常常一起玩儿，所以感到寂寞时总想他们。
lesson2.en: When I was at home, we often played together, so when I feel lonely I always think of them.
lesson2.pinyin: zàijiā shí， wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ wánr， suǒyǐ gǎndào jìmò shí zǒngxiǎng tāmen。

lesson2.cn: 今天晚上礼堂有舞会，我们一起去跳跳舞吧。
lesson2.en: There's a dance in the auditorium tonight; let's go dancing together.
lesson2.pinyin: jīntiān wǎnshàng lǐtáng yǒu wǔhuì， wǒmen yìqǐ qù tiàotiao wǔ ba。

lesson2.en: You'll feel better after having some fun.

lesson2.pinyin: chī le wǎnfàn jiù qù ba。

lesson2.cn: 你在宿舍等我，我来叫你。
lesson2.en: Wait for me in the dorm; I'll come get you.
lesson2.pinyin: nǐ zài sùshè děng wǒ， wǒlái jiào nǐ。
